title: Data Processing Pipeline
content:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from typing import List, Optional

class DataProcessor:
    """Processes and transforms data for machine learning pipelines."""
    
    def __init__(self, config: dict):
        self.config = config
        self.data: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None
    
    def load_data(self, filepath: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Load data from a CSV file."""
        self.data = pd.read_csv(filepath)
        return self.data
    
    def normalize(self, columns: List[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Normalize specified columns using z-score normalization."""
        for col in columns:
            mean = self.data[col].mean()
            std = self.data[col].std()
            self.data[col] = (self.data[col] - mean) / std
        return self.data
    
    def filter_outliers(self, column: str, threshold: float = 3.0) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Remove outliers beyond threshold standard deviations."""
        mean = self.data[column].mean()
        std = self.data[column].std()
        self.data = self.data[
            (self.data[column] >= mean - threshold * std) &
            (self.data[column] <= mean + threshold * std)
        ]
        return self.data

def main():
    processor = DataProcessor({'batch_size': 1000})
    data = processor.load_data('data.csv')
    normalized = processor.normalize(['age', 'income'])
    filtered = processor.filter_outliers('income')
    print(f"Processed {len(filtered)} records")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
